Switzerland / CITY EDIT

Ten cities to start with.

Compare the city guide ↗
01 / Switzerland

Zurich

Zurich combines medieval lanes along the Limmat with lakeside promenades and major art museums.

Explore Zurich ↗02 / Switzerland

Geneva

Geneva brings together international institutions, a hillside old town and Lake Geneva's waterfront.

Explore Geneva ↗03 / Switzerland

Basel

Basel pairs a medieval Rhine-side centre with a concentration of art museums.

Explore Basel ↗04 / Switzerland

Bern

Bern's arcaded old town occupies a peninsula enclosed by a bend in the Aare.

Explore Bern ↗05 / Switzerland

Lucerne

Lucerne combines covered wooden bridges and painted old-town façades beside its Alpine lake.

Explore Lucerne ↗06 / Switzerland

Lausanne

Lausanne rises from Lake Geneva through steep streets to a Gothic cathedral and historic centre.

Explore Lausanne ↗07 / Switzerland

Lugano

Lugano combines Italian-speaking Swiss culture with lakeside gardens and mountain viewpoints.

Explore Lugano ↗08 / Switzerland

St. Gallen

St. Gallen centres on an abbey district renowned for its baroque library and religious architecture.

Explore St. Gallen ↗09 / Switzerland

Chur

Chur's winding old-town streets sit beneath Alpine slopes at a gateway to Graubünden.

Explore Chur ↗10 / Switzerland

Winterthur

Winterthur combines a pedestrian old town with art collections and Switzerland's hands-on science centre.

Explore Winterthur ↗
